answer: Each seat is bound to one AS that publishes an RPKI ROA covering a dedicated /24 announced for 14 days. Five beacons chosen by H(epoch-seed || ASN) traceroute to a reserved hollow /32 in that prefix and must see the same origin AS as the path vertex within eight hops and 12 seconds. A second key announcing the same ASN, or a ROA already bound to another seat, burns 220 POA and merges both claims, so relabeling one prefix cannot mint extra votes. RPKI snapshots sit in a public basalt archive for four epochs so peers can replay the bind; leftover collateral refunds after three sealed answers.
